q1.q: How can I submit a support request?
q1.a: Choose the type of support you need above, fill in the request form and click Send Request. You can also call us or message us on WhatsApp.

q2.q: What types of requests does PrimeServe support?
q2.a: Procurement and supply orders, facility services such as maintenance and cleaning, HR and employee services, technical help with the website, finance and invoice questions, and any other business support need.

q3.q: Can I attach files or photos?
q3.a: Yes. After you send your request, our team will contact you and you can share any files or photos with them directly by email or WhatsApp.

q4.q: How long does it take to get a response?
q4.a: We respond based on the priority you choose. Urgent requests are handled first, and we always confirm that we received your request.

q5.a: Yes. Any team member can submit a request. Just add the branch or location in the form so we can direct it to the right team.

q6.q: Can I track the status of my request?
q6.a: Yes. Our team keeps you updated by phone, email or WhatsApp at every step until the request is closed.
